validation.checkpoint_role: Historical prompt-validation checkpoint; retained in the local archive.

lobo.limitations: Public development LOBO, one seed; not a CodaBench score.

plan.epoch_policy: Median inner-validation best epoch, rounded half up.
plan.learning_rate_policy: Per-epoch median of the four inner-validation learning-rate histories; carry the last rate forward after a fold ends.
plan.note: The schedule is frozen before fitting; no validation labels remain for adaptive stopping.

final.evaluation_note: Full-data metrics are in-sample, not validation, LOBO, or a CodaBench score.

packaging.note: Local packaging checks only; no CodaBench submission was made.
